dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual narrowing of the visible 2D lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Distinct asymmetrical protrusion on the left lateral margin near the mid-body, contrasted by a smoother right lateral margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-toned slate-grey with high-intensity specular reflections along the central dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-grey tonal variations localized primarily in the anterior and mid-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey pigmented regions and lighter-toned surface highlights.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple parallel linear light-colored marks (rake marks) visible on the anterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scarring or rake marks observed on the dorsal surface posterior to the head region.
